title: FeatureWorkService
responsibility: Read committed feature plans and task progress from one project queue revision.

inputs.name: FeatureWorkService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: Trusted reader of one project's committed task queue; required for read().

outputs.name: FeatureWorkService.read
outputs.description: Reads the queue once and returns its commit and each feature's highest-revision plan plus its own stored tasks. Task status is unchanged; blockedBy contains same-feature dependencies not accepted, including missing IDs. Plans and task arrays are defensive copies. Task projections omit claims, execution output, worktree and task file grants.

errors.name: missing repository or failed queue read
errors.description: Rejects without fabricating a result; repository errors propagate.
